name: Obstacles
overview: Scripture reveals that obstacles in the believer's life are not insurmountable when trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages reliance on God rather than human understanding. God's presence and protection through trials—symbolized by waters and fire in Isaiah 43:2—assure believers that adversity will not overcome them. Faith, even as small as a mustard seed, holds power to remove seemingly immovable barriers, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 17:20. Furthermore, God actively prepares the way by removing stumbling blocks for His people (Isaiah 57:14), and His strength enables believers to overcome challenges with confidence, as seen in Psalms 18:29 and Exodus 14:14.
